# Montclair State University

> Montclair State University is a comprehensive public research institution offering 300+ academic programs across 14 colleges, with robust admissions, online learning, and student support resources.

Located in Montclair, New Jersey, Montclair State serves as a major regional university with strong offerings in business, music, arts, and education. The institution emphasizes accessibility, innovation, and community engagement through its diverse academic portfolio and strategic initiatives.

## Admissions & Enrollment

- [Apply To Montclair State University](https://www.montclair.edu/apply-to-montclair-state): Application portal for undergraduate and graduate admissions
- [Visit Us](https://www.montclair.edu/admissions/visit-us): Campus visit scheduling, tours, and admitted student events at MSU
- [Tuition And Fees](https://www.montclair.edu/tuition-and-fees): Tuition costs, fees, and net price calculator for Montclair State

- [Online](https://www.montclair.edu/online): Online degree and certificate programs through Montclair Online platform
